description.content:
Get the list of registered hostnames and their risks. You can use the omit_risks,
omit_vendor, omit_score and omit_labels query parameter to turn off these information
from the response and quickly get a list of registered hostnames.

This is an add-on endpoint not available to all accounts. Please contact support for information about bulk endpoints and how to upgrade your account.

Required API key permissions: `Admin` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)

query.description: The `page_token` from a previous request, use this to get the next page of results.
The number of results to return per page.
Whether to sort the results in descending order.
Omit the scan information, i.e. risks, score and last scanned at.
Omit the vendor information for a hostname in the response.
Omit the labels for a hostname in the response.
Exclude active hostnames from the results.
Exclude inactive hostnames from the results.
Filter results to only hostnames that have all the provided labels.

response.name: Returns the list of hostnames and their risks.

request.name: Register a list of hostnames to be scanned for risks

description.content:
Register a list of hostnames to be scanned for risks. The provided hostnames must be fully qualified domain names
or IPv4 addresses. Currently, a maximum of 1000 hostnames in a single request is supported. This will always replace
the labels of currently registered hostnames and if the request has empty labels they will all be removed.

This is an add-on endpoint not available to all accounts. Please contact support for information about bulk endpoints and how to upgrade your account.

Required API key permissions: `Admin` (select when creating API key in Account Settings)
